title: Facet load share (% of applied compression) in lumbar FSUs, 1112 N centric and 10 mm eccentric
condition: intact posterior elements; intervertebral load cell (IVLC) in a slot cut in the vertebral body, anterior longitudinal ligament cut

quantity.name: facet load share
quantity.definition: facet load = applied axial load - IVLC (disc) load, as % of applied load, at 1112 N peak; includes any posterior-ligament contribution; mean, SD, min/max over specimens (Table 3, two-vertebrae segments)

source.sample: 6 two-vertebrae lumbar segments (L1-L2 x2, L3-L4 x1, L4-L5 x3) from 4 cadavers (specimens 3, 6, 7, 8 of Table 1); Galante disc grade 2-3 where reported

protocol.summary: Segments potted in Ostalloy (end surfaces parallel) and loaded in an Instron through a 750-mm plate with a semicircular loading head, symmetric about the mid-sagittal plane; lower support on an adjustable table to set eccentricity (measured from the centre of the vertebral body; 10 mm anterior to 12.5 mm posterior). Ramp compression 93 N/s to 1112 N, unloading 93 N/s, 5 min rest between cycles. Test repeated after inserting a 12-mm, 38-mm-diameter IVLC into a slot in the lower vertebral body (ALL cut); facet load = applied - IVLC load.
how_to_simulate: Model a two-vertebrae lumbar FSU (L1-L2, L3-L4 or L4-L5); fix the caudal vertebra, leave the cranial end free to settle
Apply 1112 N vertical compression through the vertebral-body centre, or 10 mm anterior / 10 mm posterior to it
Report total facet (posterior-element) force normal to the disc as % of the applied load
protocol.notes: Two-vertebrae data only (Table 3). Three-vertebrae segment data (Table 4, 2.5-mm eccentricity steps, two degenerated L3-L5 specimens) and isolated-facet stiffness are outside the card scope. Specimen 3 is marked 'facet joint test only' in Table 1 but appears in Table 3 (as printed).

extraction.check_notes: Scanned PDF read at 250 dpi. Review values 25.1+/-5.0, 22.3+/-2.4 confirmed; review posterior SD 7.0 -> 7.11 (Table 3). Review load '1.1 kN' = 1112 N. per_specimen order: 3 L3-L4, 6 L1-L2, 6 L4-L5, 7 L1-L2, 7 L4-L5, 8 L4-L5.
